steps.text: 1. The Tourist taps the floating "Ask the assistant" button or opens the Chat page. A1.
2. The system checks that the chatbot is enabled and loads the history of the current chat session (if any). E1, A2.

exceptions.text: E1. The chatbot is disabled → the floating button is hidden; the Chat page shows "The chatbot is disabled". Session expired → the client starts an empty session.

steps.text: 3. The system shows the greeting "Hello! What would you like to explore today?" and suggested questions.
4. The Tourist types a question (1–1000 characters) or picks a suggestion and sends it. E2.

exceptions.text: E2. Empty question or over 1000 characters → 422 "Invalid question. Please enter 1 to 1000 characters."

steps.text: 5. The client sends the question (with the location if permission was given or the question says "near me"); the Gateway rate-limits by IP and forwards it to the AI service. E3.

exceptions.text: E3. Limit exceeded (5 turns / minute, 100 turns / day per IP) → 429 "You have asked too many questions in a short time, please try again in …".

steps.text: 6. The AI service detects the language and intent, finds up to 5 matching tours / places (hybrid vector + graph search), calls the LLM once (Gemini, Groq as fallback) and keeps only citations that are in the search results. A3, E4.

exceptions.text: E4. AI is busy (moderation has priority) or the Gemini quota is exceeded with no Groq → 429 "The assistant is busy, please try again in …"; every LLM provider fails or the gateway cannot reach AI → 503 "The assistant is temporarily not responding, please try again later."; content blocked by the provider → a polite refusal.

steps.text: 7. The system returns the answer progressively (streaming); citations appear as numbered links with a "Sources" list. A4, E5.

exceptions.text: E5. Error mid-stream → "The assistant hit an error while answering, please try again."; connection lost → "Connection lost, the answer is incomplete."; the stream closes before any text → "The assistant did not answer, please try again."; no Retry button (it appears only for errors before the stream starts: no network, 429, 503).

steps: A1. Full screen: from the floating chat panel choose "Open full screen" → the Chat page with the same session.
A2. New conversation: the Tourist chooses "New conversation"; the next question creates a new session.
A3.1. Out-of-scope question (weather, programming / maths, finance, politics, news, booking, prices, personal data) with no travel words → a canned answer, no LLM call.
A3.2. No matching tour / place found → a canned answer, no LLM call.
A3.3. Small talk greeting → answered with one LLM call, no index search.
A4. Stop the answer: the Tourist taps "Stop"; the system cancels the stream and keeps the part received with the "Stopped" label; the session history still has the full answer.
